title: Positivity of the noise operator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f\colon\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(y)\ge0$ for every $y$. Then the noise operator with parameter $\rho$ satisfies $(T_\rho f)(x)\ge0$ for every $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$f(y)\ge0$ for every point $y$ of that cube
$x$ is a point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube
